title: Art and Influence
content: A bountiful new art blog called "Art and Influence," has just burst upon the scene. The blog is the work of Virginia plein-air painterArmand Cabreraand Diane Burket.In less than a month since its inception, they have hit the ground running with dozens of posts on Armand's traditional painting instruction, mainly in oil landscapes. There is also a rich collection of biographical spotlights from art history, focusing on realist/impressionist painters of the 19th and 20th centuries, complete with quotes and bibliographies.Many of these posts were adapted from material Armand and Diane created for the websiteOutdoor Painting.------------Art and Influence blog,link.Armand Cabrera website,link.Outdoor Painting website,link.GJ post about painting with Armand earlier this year,link.
